At the time it was released, Wings Over America was widely known for having live versions of Wings songs that were superior to their studio counterparts. And that goes for every single song from Venus and Mars – without exception the live versions are better.
The excitement of having a live audience gives the live versions of the songs from the album a much-needed jolt of energy.
The album also garnered highly positive reviews from critics and significantly restored McCartney's tarnished post-Beatles reputation.
The album saw the first time a Wings' album featured every member on lead vocals at least once.
